outcome.technical: Fix 1 (scripts/pipeline.mjs): BRIEF_TRIMS gains four terminal rungs after 'floor names beyond 160 characters': 'floor names (the count stays)' (floorRoom 0: floorLines leaves out the 'Each of these needs its own node' line, the head with count and parts stays), 'globs beyond 40 characters' (globRoom 40), 'app names (their count stays)' (new appShort option: '- Workspace apps: N, listed in the summary; their app nodes are made by script, write none.'), and 'intro and the work step's last clause' (new terse option: one-line intro, Work step 2 without its 'then what prescan cannot see' clause). The fourth rung is beyond the three the task names: with only those three the p29 pathological area (30 globs, 37 entry-point groups, 52 clients, 12 route groups, 9 middleware, 14 modules, 6 apps, 200-character work path) still measured 4036 characters; with it, 3902. BRIEF_TRIMS and fitExplorerBrief are now exported; writeBrief's throw stays as the last guard. Contract and Reply sections and the summary/fragment paths are never touched by any rung. Fix 2 (scripts/lib/prescan/partition.mjs): exported SMALL=3 and new LEFTOVER_AREAS=3. Cap loop rule: keep = max(1, min(LEFTOVER_AREAS, maxAreas)); while areas > maxAreas, merge the two smallest leftovers only while more than keep leftovers remain; fold a leftover into the smallest app only when it is the single leftover left AND has fewer than SMALL files; otherwise stop (area count may exceed maxAreas by what the apps need). Header comment rewritten. pc14 changed where the rule changed: 'areas <= 8' became 'areas <= 8 apps + 3' and 'leftover areas <= 3', plus each app area holds only its own glob; the 'few' and 'many' cases are unchanged and still pass. Fix 3: python.mjs emits middleware [{name,file,line}] (decorator @<recv>.middleware("http") over the next def, line of the decorator; <recv>.add_middleware(<Class>, ...) with the last dotted segment of the first positional argument, line of the call; matched on the string-masked source) and modules [paths]: for every .py entry point that genericRecipe names (same basename rule as the generic entry points, called on the .py files only so it reads nothing), the .py files in the same directory with a top-level def/class (masked source, so a def inside a string does not count), excluding __init__.py, test_*.py, *_test.py, conftest.py and the entry point itself; deduped, code-unit sorted. Neither is in KINDS, so skipped/truncated keys are unchanged (py7 holds). inventory.mjs: new joinMiddleware(modules, named) -> sorted union where '<file>:<name>' stands in for a bare entry of the same file; directory entries stay. prescan.mjs: 'modules' in KEY_ORDER after 'middleware', copied per area from py.modules; per-area python middleware joined into slice.middleware via joinMiddleware; SUMMARY_WEIGHT modules: 3. pipeline.mjs coverageFloor: a 'modules' group (key 'modules', label 'modules', only where non-empty) counts into the floor; Work step 2 now reads 'per router, handler or listed module of a backend'. Fixture python-api: app/main.py gets CORSMiddleware add_middleware (line 43) and @app.middleware("http") check_db_ready (line 46), appended so earlier line numbers hold; new app/auth.py (class TokenVerifier) and app/cache_utils.py (def book_key); README rows added.
